title: Blur
description: A family of blurs for a live source: a plain Gaussian, a directional motion blur along any angle, a radial zoom blur streaking out from a centre, and a spin blur smearing around it. Motion, zoom and spin are accumulation blurs — many faint offset, scaled or rotated copies averaged together, with a quality/samples control — and the zoom/spin centre is mappable so the origin can be driven live. Amount is audio-mappable. Works on the camera, a dropped clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
